Indoor Air Quality Systems Costs by Type

We offer a variety of cutting-edge indoor air quality solutions tailored to the unique needs of Greenville area homes. Here’s a breakdown of common systems and their average costs:

Whole-Home Air Purifiers:
  • Benefits: Removes airborne contaminants like pollen, dust, and allergens. Ideal for families with allergies or asthma, ensuring every breath is cleaner and healthier.
Dehumidifiers:
  • Benefits: Reduces excess moisture, preventing mold growth and improving overall comfort. Perfect for homes in humid climates like Greenville, Greer, and Mauldin.
Humidifiers:
  • Benefits: Adds moisture to dry indoor air, preventing static electricity, dry skin, and respiratory discomfort during winter months.
UV Light Air Purification Systems:
  • Benefits: Eliminates bacteria, viruses, and mold spores from your HVAC system, providing an added layer of health protection for your family.

Indoor Air Quality Upgrades

For homeowners looking to take control of their air quality, consider these advanced upgrades:

Air Scrubbers

  • These systems attach to your HVAC unit and use advanced filtration to reduce airborne pathogens, allergens, and odors. Air scrubbers are ideal for households with pets or individuals with respiratory sensitivities.

Energy Recovery Ventilators (ERVs)

  • ERVs bring fresh air into your home while retaining the energy from outgoing air. They’re perfect for energy-efficient homes where fresh air circulation is limited, ensuring a constant flow of healthy air.

Zoning Systems for Air Quality

  • Divide your home into zones with independent air quality controls to ensure each area receives the proper treatment it needs. Zoning systems allow you to target problem areas, optimizing comfort and efficiency.
